name: tool-schema-lint
description: A reliability linter for the JSON tool/function schemas you give an LLM. Flags the pitfalls that make agents pick the wrong tool or fill arguments wrong — thin descriptions, undocumented params, untyped fields, and `required` entries that reference properties that don't exist. Supports Anthropic and OpenAI tool formats.

scripts.test: node index.mjs examples/good-tools.json && node index.mjs examples/bad-tools.json || true

author: Penloom Studio
